item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your calendar is full of good prompts: check whether this moment supports the life you want, break negative patterns, and ask whether you're projecting or mind reading. Those only work if you actually stop and answer them. Don't just read them and move on. Pick one moment today, pause, and name the thought you're having. Then ask whether it's a fact or a story. Do that once, out loud.
